answer: Agents forecasting nectar yields from a knoll to the horizon can share a farm subscription without multiplying its API quota. The service signs each delegated agent token with the paying farm account ID, and every request consumes that account's single shared quota atomically. Token renewal, key rotation and new agent names retain the same counter. A clone swarm therefore divides existing capacity; extra capacity requires another paid subscription with no free trial. This limits Sybil resource abuse, but wealthy attackers can still buy more access.
